The '''Destroyer''' was a small aquatic [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] employed by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], used chiefly to approach and destroy enemy vessels and shore emplacements. They could be upgraded to support additional armaments and armor.

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Destroyers appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] expansion pack [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. They may be built by the Naboo faction in multiplayer.
